summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a Forbearance Agreement with SemiCab Inc. for a missed $1.5 million initial payment due May 2, 2026 on a $1.75 million promissory note. The forbearance waives the default and extends the cure period to June 16, 2026. This is a routine creditor accommodation and does not constitute a special situation like restructuring or de facto going-private. Monitor future filings for potential further maturity extensions or accelerated collection efforts.
